meta-runner.name: GoodHacker DAST scan
meta-runner.description: Lanza un escaneo DAST de GoodHacker y aplica los criterios de la build

param.name: env.GH_DAST_API_URL
param.spec: text description='URL base de la API (…/dast/api/v1)' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: ghdast.webapp.id
param.spec: text description='ID de la aplicación' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: ghdast.args
param.spec: text description='Criterios y opciones de ghdast scan' display='normal'

param.name: ghdast.cli.sha256
param.spec: text description='SHA-256 esperado de la CLI (opcional)' display='normal'

parameters.param: #!/bin/sh set -e python3 -c "import urllib.request,os;u=os.environ['GH_DAST_API_URL'].rstrip('/').rsplit('/',1)[0]+'/cli/ghdast.py';urllib.request.urlretrieve(u,'ghdast.py')" if [ -n "%ghdast.cli.sha256%" ]; then echo "%ghdast.cli.sha256% ghdast.py" | sha256sum -c -; fi set +e python3 ghdast.py scan --webapp-id "%ghdast.webapp.id%" %ghdast.args% code=$? echo "##teamcity[publishArtifacts 'ghdast-results => ghdast-results']" exit $code
